what: When the top edge of the photo cell touches the bottom of the screen, an accent cover, a circle centered outside the cell’s top left (-65% 0%), grows from 50% to 200% over .9s and covers the cell (ff_expo_in_out). At that moment the photo is switched on, then the cover shrinks as a circle centered outside the bottom right (165% 100%) from 200% to 50% and clears over 1.2s (ff_expo_out). The photo inside settles from 1.1x into place over 1.4s at the same time — a color band sweeps across diagonally and leaves the photo behind. Plays once

options.zoom: Starting size of the inner photo, default 1.1 — 1 keeps it as is
options.speed: Overall speed multiplier, default 1 — original team photo is 1.4
options.ease-in: Cover curve (Bezier values, SVG path or GSAP name), default the original ff_expo_in_out path
options.ease-out: Lift-away and photo curve, default original ff_expo_out path
options.[data-fx-part=img]: Photo (child) that turns on and shrinks — defaults to first child

note: Curves take the original CustomEase paths (ff_expo_in_out·ff_expo_out) through kfFx.ease — if CustomEase is not loaded, expo.inOut·expo.out

from.where: index.html .mv-careers__image · about.html .mv-tmedia__media·.mv-member__image (speed 1.4) — original media-reveal: circle(50%→200% at -65% 0%) .9s ff_expo_in_out, circle(200%→50% at 165% 100%) 1.2s ff_expo_out, photo scale 1.1→1 1.4s
